I have been trying to perfect a good pasta sauce, but it always comes out bitter. Is there anyway to counteract that without adding sugar?

Onions are your friend! Sauté some finely chopped onions in a pan until they're soft, then add to your pasta sauce and it enhances the flavour greatly. Or you could try adding some onion powder, garlic paste, some (fresh if you can) basil and chives, it really enhances the flavour. You could also look in the shops for something called "Italian Seasoning", it greatly evens out the taste in pasta sauces.

Another thing I'd like to add, try adding a crumbled stock cube in a splash of water or powdered bullion, it's basically a splash of instant flavour.

If you still have problems with bitterness, try switching from canned tomatoes (if you're using those) and try making passata from fresh tomatoes. And also try adding seasoning near the end of cooking your sauce, as some bitterness comes from over cooking seasoning/spices.

Hope this helps out a bit!
